items.title: Raymond Realty shares dive 12% after Q1 profit drops 19% to ₹13.4 crore
items.description: Raymond Realty has reported a 19 per cent decline in its consolidated net profit to ₹13.43 crore for the quarter ended June on higher operational expenses.

items.title: Bharat Forge shares crash 9% after ₹90 crore Q1 loss; here's what mgmt said
items.description: Bharat Forge shares: Bharat Forge's management said that for FY27, it continues to maintain a growth outlook of 20-25 per cent for the Indian manufacturing business.

items.title: Kwality Pharma, Aarti Pharmalabs, Universal Cables hit 20% upper circuits
items.description: The share price of Kwality Pharmaceuticals hit a new high of ₹3,130.85 on Monday. The stock zoomed 183% thus far in the calendar year 2026.

items.title: Lenskart Solutions market cap crosses ₹1 trillion; stock hits new high
items.description: Thus far in the calendar year 2026, Lenskart Solutions surged 33 per cent as against a 7.7 per cent decline in the BSE Sensex.

items.title: Bernstein's outperform rating on Paytm sees stock jump 8% on Monday
items.description: Paytm Share: Bernstein's target price of ₹2,200 is the first brokerage target to exceed Paytm's IPO price. The target implies an upside of 52 per cent from the previous close of ₹1,441.

items.title: Lupin dips 4%, hits seven-week low; what's making the Street nervous?
items.description: In the past month, Lupin underperformed the market by falling 9 per cent, as against a 1.4 per cent gain in the BSE Sensex and a 2.6 per cent rally in the BSE Healthcare index.

items.title: Britannia, HUL, M&M: UBS picks stocks to play the rural recovery theme
items.description: Shriram Finance (up 28 per cent), Eicher Motors (up 22 per cent), Cholamandalam Financial Holdings (up 19 per cent) and M&M (up 19 per cent) have outperformed Nifty 50 this far in FY27, data shows.

items.title: SBI dips 1.5% despite all-round Q1 beat: Opportunity to buy PSU stock?
items.description: SBI Share: Analysts largely maintained bullish views on SBI shares following the Q1 results, foreseeing a 22 per cent upside from last closing price.

items.title: Hitachi Energy shares zoom 10% after Q1 PAT rises 2x ; brokerages hike TP
items.description: Hitachi Energy shares: Today's buying activity in Hitachi Energy was buoyed by the company's stellar Q1 numbers, with its net profit jumping more than twofold Y-o-Y to ₹294.2 crore in Q1FY27.

items.title: Jewellery stocks in focus: Titan hits new high, Sky Gold up 14%; here's why
items.description: India has a strong opportunity to emerge as a global hub for design-led jewellery manufacturing, supported by its manufacturing capabilities, craftsmanship and more FTAs, says Senco Gold.

items.title: Hero MotoCorp rallies 4%, hits 8-month high; what's driving 2W stock price?
items.description: Hero MotoCorp stock rallied 7% in 2 days after the management said it expects the domestic 2W industry to sustain momentum, and sees double-digit industry growth in FY27.

items.title: Ola shares tank 6% after Q1 show; Emkay sees 27% downside. Time to sell?
items.description: Emkay retained a 'Sell' call on Ola's stock with a target price of Rs 30 (down 26.8 per cent from last close) and opted to play the E-2W theme via Ather and TVS.

items.title: Inox Wind shares crack 6%, hit 52-wk low post Q1 miss; should you buy?
items.description: Net profit of Inox Wind fell 34.2 per cent to ₹64.1 crore in the quarter ended June 2026 as against ₹97.3 crore during the previous quarter ended June 2025.

items.title: DII equity inflows top Rs 5 trillion for third straight calendar year
items.description: Within the Nifty-500, DIIs were overweight in Consumer, public sector undertaking (PSU) Banks, Oil & Gas, Telecom, Metals, and Technology sectors in the June 2026 quarter, reports suggest.
